data.data:
Dear Endministrator,


Arknights: Endfield pre-download is now available! You can download and install the game and its resources in advance. Due to the large download size, we recommend downloading over a stable Wi-Fi connection.

Arknights: Endfield will officially release worldwide on Jan. 22, 2026 at 11:00 AM (UTC+8) across all platforms. We look forward to seeing you on Talos-II, Endministrator!


>>Download game from official website<<


▼// About Pre-Download

Available Platforms: PlayStation®5, PC, Android, iOS, Epic Games Store

About Cross-Platform Saves: Save data under the same account is synced across different platforms.

※ If your device still has an older Arknights: Endfield client from a previous test, we recommend uninstalling it before downloading the official release version.

※ If you've pre-ordered Arknights: Endfield on the PlayStation™Store, open the PlayStation™Store on your PlayStation®5 and search for Arknights: Endfield to pre-download.


▼// System Requirements

PC: 50GB or more free space (an additional 40GB is required when extracting files)

※ Install on an SSD for better gaming experiences.

iOS: 25GB or more free space

Android: 25GB or more free space

PS5: 60GB or more free space


For a smooth installation and gaming experience, please check out the following minimum and recommended system requirements:


[PC]

- System Requirements

Operating System: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11 64-bit

DirectX Version: 11.1 or higher

- Processor

Recommended: Intel Core i7-10700K or equivalent or higher

Minimum: Intel Core i5-9400F or equivalent

- GPU

Recommended: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or equivalent or higher, with the latest GPU drivers installed

Minimum: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent

- RAM

Recommended: 16GB or higher

Minimum: 16GB


- Storage:

50GB or more free space (an additional 40GB is required when extracting files)

※ Install on an SSD for better gaming experiences.


[Android]

- Operating System

Recommended: Android 11.0, or HarmonyOS 4.0.0 or higher versions (HarmonyOS NEXT currently not supported)

Minimum: Android 10.0, or HarmonyOS 2.0.0 or higher versions (HarmonyOS NEXT currently not supported)

- Processor

Recommended: Snapdragon 8+ Gen1 / Dimensity 9000 / Kirin 9000S or equivalent or higher

Minimum: Snapdragon 855 / Dimensity 1000 / Kirin 990 or equivalent

- RAM

Recommended: 8GB or higher

Minimum: 6GB

- Compatibility Requirements

Except for Imagination's D-Series, other PowerVR GPUs are not supported.

- Storage

25GB or more free space


[iOS]

- Operating System

iOS 15.0, iPad OS 15.0 or higher

- Device

Recommended: iPhone 13 Pro, or an iPad with an A15 chip or later

Minimum: iPhone XS, or an iPad with an A12 chip or later

- RAM

Recommended: 6GB or higher

Minimum: 4GB

- Storage

25GB or more free space


[PlayStation®5]

- Storage

60GB or more free space


※ Game performance, stability, and graphics are still being optimized. Running the game on devices that do not meet the minimum requirements may cause issues like stuttering and frame drops. Thank you for your understanding and support, Endministrator!


▼// About GRYPHLINK

On PC, pre-downloads will be handled through GRYPHLINK.

※ Older GRYPHLINK versions from previous tests cannot download the official release client. Please uninstall the old launcher before downloading the game.

■ If you haven't installed GRYPHLINK:

Download the GRYPHLINK installation pack, then extract and install the game launcher. After that, you can download the Arknights: Endfield client.

■ If you've already installed GRYPHLINK:

Open the game launcher, click [All Games] in the bottom-left corner, then click [Arknights: Endfield] to switch to the game page and download the client.


▼// Pre-Download FAQs

If you encounter any issues during pre-download, please contact our customer support via:

endfield_cs@gryphline.com
